title: Harry Styles Drops New Limited-Edition Loop Earplugs: Here’s Where to Buy a Pair Online
summary: The line of earplugs is inspired by Styles' latest album Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The company Loop manufactures stylish earplugs and has a new collaboration with Harry Styles ‘ unisex beauty and lifestyle brand, Pleasing.

The duo just dropped a pair of Loop Experience 2 earplugs  in stylish psychedelic hues, matching the disco aesthetic of Style’s latest album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally . The earplugs, in colors “Loud Enough” and “Love Enough,” both retail for $39.95.

Loud Enough is a blue metallic hue described as being inspired by the “energy and intensity of live sound.” The Love Enough style is a pink metallic hue, inspired by “the emotion and connection experienced at live events.” Both limited-edition earplugs are nestled in coordinating carrying cases and are available to shop now on Loop’s website.

The whole goal of earplugs like these is to marry fashion and function, giving prospective buyers more interesting options than your standard earplugs.

in Love Enough

Loop was founded in Antwerp, Belgium, back in 2016. These earplugs are reusable and come nestled in a carrying case.

Unlike your traditional earplugs that block sound, Loop’s offerings filter sound to reduce overall volume, while keeping speech and music clear. This makes Loop earplugs a must-have for concerts or festival settings, given that you can still hear the music clearly without damaging your eardrums.

The high-volume sound waves you are subjected to during live music events put your inner ear under intense stress. After attending a concert, some people may experience buzzing or ringing, a sign of  temporary tinnitus that eventually will go away with time. While Loop earplugs aren’t a cure for tinnitus, they can certainly help prevent it , according to the brand.

This collaboration comes at a perfect time, given that Styles just embarked on his 2026 Together, Together world tour . This tour features 50 dates in a total of seven cities with Styles visiting Europe, North America, Latin America and Australia. The first show kicked off in Amsterdam on May 16. If you are planning on attending, we implore you to buy these Styles-approved earplugs to protect your ears.

“At Pleasing, we think about the little details that enhance your day-to-day, the ones that deepen experiences and turn fleeting moments into lasting memories. Bringing that same intention to live music felt instinctive: making it clearer, more immersive, more your own, more Pleasing,” Harry Lambert, creative director of Pleasing, says in a statement. “This collaboration with Loop grew naturally from that idea, especially as something our founder has long been a fan and wearer of. Together, we designed two joyful pieces to bring a new level of clarity and care to live music, wherever you are, whatever you’re listening to.”

Pleasing was co-founded by Styles and his stylist Lambert back in 2021. The brand features a slew of products, including nail polishes and skincare products, along with fragrance, apparel and sexual wellness items.
